annotations.title: Buy one result from the results shelf (output or recipe)

description: Buys one shelf item's OUTPUT (the result files) or its RECIPE (the full recipe: model ids, harness code, settings, prompt, inputs) and returns every file in full with its sha256, a receipt and a signed proof. The price is a fraction of the measured original cost; items with an UNKNOWN cost are not for sale. Use it when shelf_search found the item you want and its offer is on sale. Use shelf_search instead to find an item, its price and a preview first. Cost: the item's offer price_usd from shelf_search (now $0.0121 to $0.01212), charged once per purchase and debited from your balance; an item with an UNKNOWN cost is not sold. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 404 unknown_item, 409 not_for_sale (cost UNKNOWN or type not priced), 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 item_unavailable (a file failed its hash check; refunded).

id.description: The shelf item id from shelf_search (items[].id).

type.description: Which offer to buy: output (the result files) or recipe (the full recipe and harness).
